question: What is the ultimate consciousness and why is it called self-awareness?
premises: Ultimate consciousness is self-luminous by nature.
That same consciousness is declared to be self-awareness.
The ordering of the whole universe depends on it.
inference: Therefore the ultimate principle is self-aware consciousness, since it alone grounds the organization of all experience.
plain_english: That ultimate consciousness, whose nature is self-luminous, is called self-awareness, because the ordering of the entire universe rests on it.
